title: DLMF 4.25 Continued Fractions: valid when z lies in the open cut plane shown in Figure 4.23.1 (i).
summary: DLMF 4.25 Continued Fractions: valid when z lies in the open cut plane shown in Figure 4.23.1 (i).
body: NIST DLMF section 4.25 (Continued Fractions) says: "valid when z lies in the open cut plane shown in Figure 4.23.1 (i). valid when z lies in the open cut plane shown in Figure 4.23.1 (ii). valid when z lies in the open cut plane shown in Figure 4.23.1 (iv). See Lorentzen and Waadeland ( 1992 , pp. 560–571) for other continued fractions involving inverse trigonometric functions. See also Cuyt et al. ( 2008 , pp. 201–203, 205–210) ." Equation 4.25.1 on the page has alt text "\tan z=\cfrac{z}{1-\cfrac{z^{2}}{3-\cfrac{z^{2}}{5-\cfrac{z^{2}}{7-}}}}\cdots,". Equation 4.25.2 on the page has alt text "\tan\left(az\right)=\cfrac{a\tan z}{1+\cfrac{(1-a^{2}){\tan}^{2}z}{3+\cfrac{(4% -a^{2}){\tan}^{2}z}{5+\cfrac{(9-a^{2}){\tan}^{2}z}{7+}}}}\cdots,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
